Bound the actual controller feedback and verified byte-identical generated.csv,model_spec.json,evidence.json and source_checks.json. Zero rows and zero scientific assumptions changed.
remaining_limitations: Source comparisons are approximate transport diagnostics; BMI distributions, disease/treatment/fasting selection, period, geography and assay platforms differ.
Three native source slopes remain materially discrepant; the available feedback does not quantify how much of the difference comes from composition, selection or fictional residual choices.
Age slopes, high-BMI hinge, common working BMI slope by sex, conditional residual scales and tails remain assumptions or assumption-dependent choices, not validated discoveries.
Smoking,alcohol,menopausal history,renal function and treatment data are unavailable; exact adjusted-source or menopause-selected checks remain noncomputable.
No builder-computed new diagnostics, verified source-population replay, target validation or scientific improvement evidence is provided.
